question: Who among the following is best known for his plays 'Yayati' and 'Tughlaq'?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Girish Karnad**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Girish Karnad:**

 
 
• Girish Karnad was an** Indian actor, film director, Kannada writer,** **playwright, and a Jnanpith awardee**, who predominantly worked **in South Indian cinema and Bollywood**.
 
• Girish Karnad wrote his first play '**Yayati' in 1961** at the age of 23 when he was still studying at Oxford.
 
• **In the story of King Yayati in Mahabharata, Yayati was cursed to old age for his sexual misconduct and he tries to avert the catastrophe by demanding his son, Pooru's, youth in exchange for the curse on him. 'What makes his version of the tale so resonant, and startlingly original**,**is that he rejects the traditional glorification of the son's 'self-sacrifice' and, against a backdrop of lust, jealousy, and racial tensions.**
 
• One of Karnad's best-known works, this **1964** play tells the story of 14th-century Delhi ruler **Muhammad Bin Tughlaq**.
 
 
• The **13-scene play **closely **paralleled 'contemporary' socio-political events in the country at that time. Known in history as the 'wisest fool', Muhammad Bin Tughlaq was a gifted man, but an unlucky one perhaps because all brilliant plans led to catastrophic results**.
 
 
 
• He received the **1998 Jnanpith Award**, the highest literary honour conferred in India.
 
• He was conferred **Padma Shri and Padma Bhushan **by the Government of India and won **four Filmfare Awards**.
 
• He continued to work in film, directing such movies as **Kanooru Heggadithi (1999) and acting in Iqbal (2005), Life Goes On (2009), and 24 (2016) etc.**
